task: Define regression command and expected outputs from the authoritative B CSV case matrix; no validator code is implemented in this round.

framework.name: CSV-authoritative no-silent-upgrade regression contract
framework.round3_position: This artifact defines the future regression command surface and expected outputs only. It is not an implementation and does not claim any command has been run.
framework.source_boundary: No A output content was read or used as a B premise in this Round 3 contract.

regression_contract.pass_rule: For every authoritative case row, observed_status must exactly equal expected_status. For all non-positive-control rows with first_failed_predicate other than NONE, observed_first_failed_predicate must preserve the declared predicate or a stricter same-family blocker; it must not silently upgrade to a stronger terminal state.
regression_contract.current_exact_os_rule: The current Srivastava summary exact O_s case remains BLOCK. The current Srivastava F01-F03 context-only case may return CONDITIONAL_CONTEXT_PASS but must not return CANDIDATE_EXACT_REPLAY, ADMITTED_EXACT, or DIAGNOSED_MISMATCH without F04-F22.
regression_contract.legacy_status_rule: PARTIAL_CONTEXT_ONLY is not an accepted emitted terminal status. Legacy partial-context inputs must be represented as BLOCK with a deprecation diagnostic, while explicit reported_context F01-F03 cases use CONDITIONAL_CONTEXT_PASS.

claims.statement: Round 3 maps every one of the 17 authoritative Round 2 CSV rows into a regression test command contract.
The expected outputs preserve exact terminal statuses from the authoritative matrix: BLOCK, CONDITIONAL_CONTEXT_PASS, CANDIDATE_EXACT_REPLAY, ADMITTED_EXACT, and DIAGNOSED_MISMATCH.
basis: expected_status column copied into the regression contract

claims.statement: The contract explicitly forbids silent upgrades: locator-only, scalar-only, numeric-closeness, executor-quality, and current-Srivastava summary evidence cannot advance to exact replay or exact admission.
Current exact Srivastava O_s remains blocked in the regression contract unless a future fixture supplies the full F01-F22 witness bundle.

deepening_1.question: What does converting the authoritative matrix into commands add beyond Round 2?
deepening_1.answer: It fixes the interface between proof obligations and implementation without writing the implementation. Each CSV row now has a concrete invocation, expected terminal, and guard target.
deepening_1.layer_1: The test set becomes a state-transition firewall: every fixture must halt at its declared terminal state unless the missing witness predicates are explicitly supplied.
deepening_1.layer_2: Because the command includes strict no-silent-upgrade and no legacy PARTIAL_CONTEXT_ONLY emission, implementation mistakes become observable as status mismatches rather than prose disagreements.

deepening_2.question: How is current exact O_s protected from accidental upgrade?
deepening_2.answer: The two Srivastava guard rows split summary-level evidence from reported-context evidence. Summary/citation evidence is BLOCK; F01-F03 context-only evidence is only CONDITIONAL_CONTEXT_PASS.
deepening_2.layer_1: Neither row can reach CANDIDATE_EXACT_REPLAY or ADMITTED_EXACT without F04-F22, so source localization is not conflated with exact observable replay.
deepening_2.layer_2: A future validator that emits ADMITTED_EXACT for the current Srivastava evidence class fails the regression contract even if the numeric value is familiar or close.

forbidden_claims: numeric closeness is sufficient for exact admission
executor quality is sufficient for exact admission
context-only evidence is exact O_s evidence
PARTIAL_CONTEXT_ONLY is a valid current terminal status
